why_separate: Regeneron printed a worldwide Libtayo line only in 2022Q3-2024Q4; the gold series is the U.S. line that runs from launch.
notes: Summary-table line 'Libtayo - Global' (whole USD millions): Regeneron-recorded worldwide net product sales. It excludes net product sales that Sanofi still recorded in certain markets during the post-July-2022 transition (about 17 million in 2022Q3 per the 2022Q3 release footnote; about 6 million in 2023Q1 per the footnote in later releases), so it differs from the detail-table Total column for 2022Q3-2023Q2.
search_log: Pulled data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0000872589.json plus CIK0000872589-submissions-001.json (older pages) and listed every 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K from 2011-06 on (script scripts/list.py); the listing kept all 8-K and 8-K/A with Item 2.02 and did not filter by form beyond that. No 8-K/A with Item 2.02 appears in the listing.

Fetched each Item 2.02 8-K's filing index.json (scripts/idx.py) and downloaded every EX-99.x exhibit (scripts/fetch.py); one earnings release per quarter was used; January JPM-conference decks and the 2023-2026 Apr/Jul/Oct preannouncement 8-Ks carry no product table and were not used.

Rows were extracted from the cached exhibits by scripts/build.py (table cells, percentage-change columns dropped) and checked with scripts/sourcing/verify_staged_manifests.py (0 failures at write time).
Cross-checks run: prior-year columns of the following year's release vs this series' own values; sum of four quarters vs the full-year figure the releases print.
Identified where the combined 'Libtayo - Global' line appears (2023Q3-2024Q4 releases) and where it is absent (2022Q3-2023Q2 own releases, 2025Q1 onward).
